name: HAE_RAE_BENCH_2.0
description:
HAE_RAE_BENCH 2.0 is a miny implementation of Big-Bench consisted of 5 tasks: date_understanding, context_definition_alignment, proverb_unscrambling, 2_digit_multiply, 
and 3_digit_subtract. 
Paper Coming Soon (probably).
reputation: A small, lightweight mini-benchmark inspired by BigBench hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption and visibility compared to larger community benchmarks.
